
=== terms (102)
The rules that apply when you book a transfer with us: how a booking is formed, what the fixed price covers, what we owe you and what we need from you.

Vamos Taxi GmbH, Bleicherstrasse 16, 8953 Dietikon ZH, Switzerland, operates this site and takes your booking.
Registered as
, company number CH-020.4.077.792-7 at the commercial register of the Canton of Zurich. Full company details are on the
These terms cover pre-booked private transfers arranged through vamostaxi.eu: airport pickups and drop-offs, city and long-distance journeys, and chauffeur bookings by the hour. They apply from the moment you confirm a booking.
We do not operate a street-hail or on-demand service. Every journey is booked ahead for a stated time, at a price agreed before you pay.
Not covered by this document
How we handle your personal data — see the
privacy policy
Cookies and consent — see the
Cancellations, changes and refunds — see the
cancellation & refund policy
, which governs.
You enter the route, the date and the time, and the number of passengers and bags. We show a price for each vehicle class. You pay. We send a written confirmation with a booking reference.
The booking exists once that confirmation reaches you. Until then nothing is reserved and nothing is charged.
What the confirmation contains
Booking reference, pickup time and pickup address.
Vehicle class, passenger and luggage count.
The price you paid, in Swiss francs.
How to change or cancel the booking.
Driver name, vehicle and telephone number are sent by SMS and email
The price shown at the last step is the price you pay. It is quoted in Swiss francs and it does not move afterwards — not for traffic, not for a longer route than expected, not for a busy evening.
The journey between the two addresses you gave us, and the driver's time for it.
Waiting time as set out in section
Tolls, road charges and airport access fees.
The gratuity. Tipping is not expected on top.
Charged separately, only if you ask for it
Additional stops:
per stop.
Waiting beyond the included allowance:
Extended city stay, maximum
minutes:
Oversized or unusual items declared at booking:
Some journeys are driven by a partner carrier working to our standards rather than by our own vehicle. You are told the vehicle class at booking; the driver's details arrive before pickup.
Give an address the driver can reach, and a mobile number you will answer on the day.
Be at the pickup point at the agreed time.
Tell us the flight number for an airport pickup, so a delay is visible to us.
Declare passengers and bags honestly — a vehicle is assigned on those numbers.
Wear a seatbelt, and keep to Swiss road law.
Smoking is not permitted in our vehicles. Alcohol and food only with the driver's agreement.
Every booked seat carries one medium case of
and one piece of hand luggage. A vehicle is assigned on the count you gave us, so tell us if it changes.
Declare in advance
Skis and snowboards, folding bicycles, collapsible wheelchairs, musical instruments, pets. We will confirm the vehicle class that takes them.
Children
Child and booster seats are available on request. You may fit your own. Swiss law decides which seat a child needs, and the driver will not travel without it.
Waiting is included, measured from the pickup time in your confirmation.
Airport pickups:
, counted from the actual landing time we see against your flight number.
All other pickups:
, counted from the booked time.
Beyond the allowance we charge
. If your flight is delayed, the allowance moves with the flight — you do not need to call us.
A booking counts as a no-show when the waiting allowance in section
has run out and we have called your number
times without an answer.
A no-show is not refunded. What we hold on record as evidence is set out in the
If the driver does not arrive
Call us on the number in your confirmation. Where we can see that you were at the pickup point and no vehicle came, the
sets out what you get back.
Change or cancel from the link in your confirmation email, or from your account if you made one. A change is effective when we confirm it in writing, not when you send it.
You pay when you book. Card payments are processed by Stripe; we never see or store your full card number.

What we do say plainly, whatever the drafting: we do not exclude liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, and nothing in these terms removes rights Swiss consumer law gives you.
Snow, closed roads, strikes, an airport shutdown: events outside anyone's control can stop a journey. Where that happens we will get you moving if it is safe and possible, and the
says what happens to the money.
What we collect, why, who processes it and how long we keep it is in the

Swiss law applies.
Should any part of these terms be unenforceable, the rest continues to apply.
Something not clear?
Cancellations, changes, complaints and no-shows all go through the same team. Quote your booking reference and we will pick it up.

=== privacy (107)
A transfer needs your name, two addresses, a time and a way to reach you. This is what happens to that information, who else touches it, and how long it stays.

Vamos Taxi GmbH is the controller of your personal data.
Controller
Vamos Taxi GmbH, Bleicherstrasse 16, 8953 Dietikon ZH, Switzerland
Contact for data
Data protection officer
Representative in the EU
Only what a transfer needs, plus what the law makes us keep. We do not buy data about you and we do not build advertising profiles.
When you get a price
Pickup and drop-off address, date and time, passenger and luggage count. This is enough to price a journey and nothing here identifies you.
When you book
Lead passenger name, email address and mobile number.
Pickup and drop-off address, and any additional stop.
Flight number, where you gave one, and the arrival time we read from it.
Passenger and luggage count, child seat requests, declared items.
Anything you type into the notes field for the driver.
When you pay
Payment metadata only: the amount, the currency, the method, the last four digits, and whether it succeeded. Card numbers are entered on Stripe's own form and never reach our systems.
While you use the site
Server logs — page, timestamp, referrer, browser, operating system and IP address — and whatever the cookie categories you allowed are set to collect. See the
When you contact us
Your message and the channel it came in on, kept with the booking it refers to.
To perform the contract
Taking a booking, assigning a driver, collecting payment, sending your confirmation and driver details, handling a change or a cancellation.
Legal obligation
Accounting, tax, and the trip records Swiss archiving law requires us to hold — see section
Legitimate interest
Fraud prevention, service quality, evidence of a no-show, and defending a claim.
Consent
Analytics and marketing cookies, and any newsletter. You can withdraw it at any time without giving a reason.
Suppliers who handle data on our instructions, under contract, and for nothing else.

Two things are true at once, and this page shows them side by side rather than burying one of them.
You can ask us to
Give you a copy of what we hold
Correct anything that is wrong
Delete what we are not required to keep
Restrict or object to a particular use
Send your data to another provider
Withdraw a consent you gave
We have to keep
Trip records for
years
Payment and tax records
The record of your cookie choice
Evidence relating to an open claim
So a deletion request does not erase a journey we are legally obliged to archive. What we can delete, we delete. What we cannot, we tell you about, and we say which rule keeps it and when it expires.
You can also complain to the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner in Bern, and — if you are in the EU — to your national authority. We would rather you came to us first.
Strictly necessary cookies keep a booking working. Everything else is off until you switch it on, and you can change your mind at any time.

, or
open your cookie preferences
with the booking reference if there is one. We answer within
days.
We may ask you to confirm who you are before we send data anywhere — for your protection, not as an obstacle.
When this policy changes we update the date and the version at the top of the page. If a change affects what you agreed to, we ask you again rather than assuming.
Want a copy of your data?
Ask, and we will send what we hold. One person handles these requests, so quote the booking reference if your question is about a journey.

=== cookies (49)
Four categories, one of which you cannot switch off because the booking would stop working. The other three are off until you say otherwise.

Changing your mind
The previous site
Related documents
Small files a site stores in your browser, plus the equivalents — local storage and pixels. We group them by what they are for, not by the technology.
Nothing except the strictly necessary category is set before you choose. If you never choose, nothing else is ever set.
Read from this browser, so it is the real state, not an example.
Necessary · on
Change preferences
Reset my choice
Resetting clears the record and brings the banner back, which is also how you check what a first-time visitor sees.
Set for everyone, no consent needed, because without them a booking cannot be taken or paid for.
Strictly necessary — cannot be switched off
Purpose
Provider
Duration
Keeps you signed in and holds the booking while you fill it in
Vamos Taxi · Supabase
Records which categories you allowed, so we can prove it and stop asking
__stripe_mid · __stripe_sid
Fraud checks on the payment step
Routes your request and keeps the site available
Convenience only. Decline them and everything still works, you just retype more.
Functional — off until you allow them
Remembers whether you read the site in English or German
Offers your last pickup address the next time you book
Which step of a booking people give up on, and which errors are breaking. Aggregated, and never used to make a decision about you.
Analytics — off until you allow them
Counts visits and measures where a booking is abandoned
Links an error report to the session that produced it
Nothing in this category is running today. It is here because the moment a paid campaign starts, something will be, and a category added later looks like a category that was hidden.
Marketing — off, and currently unused
Measures which advert or campaign led to a booking
Open your preferences from the link in the footer of every page, or from section
above. Turning a category off stops it immediately; anything already collected is handled as set out in the
privacy policy
Your browser settings also work, and they override anything we do. Blocking the strictly necessary category there will stop a booking from completing.
Change your mind any time
Your choice is a preference, not a contract. Reopen the panel whenever you like — no explanation needed.

=== cancellation (82)
Plans change. This page says exactly what happens to your money when they do — and it is the one page that decides.
Last updated
Version
Applies to
Every booking made on this site

Related documents
This page governs
Where the FAQ, a service page or the terms say anything different about windows, shares or refunds, what you read here applies. One document, one answer.
Measured from the pickup time in your confirmation, not from the time you booked.
More than
24 hours before pickup
100% refunded
Refunded to the card you paid with. Or take the full value as a voucher instead — see section
Inside
75% refunded
A driver is already committed to your journey by this point, which is what the retained share covers.
After pickup time
No-show, or not cancelled
No refund
The vehicle waited. Section
sets out when a booking counts as a no-show.
Vehicles over
seats work to a longer window of
72 hours
, because a coach cannot be re-sold at short notice.
Two routes, both ending in the same written confirmation. A cancellation counts from the moment we confirm it, so keep that email.
Booked as a guest
Use the manage-booking link in your confirmation email. It opens your booking without a password and works for one booking only.
You have an account
Sign in and open the booking under your reservations. Past journeys stay listed for your records.
Cannot reach either? Call
and quote your reference. We will do it for you and send the confirmation.
Time, address, passenger count and vehicle class can be changed up to
before pickup, free of charge. If the change moves the fare, you pay or we refund the difference — never more than the difference.
A change requested after that deadline is treated as a cancellation and a new booking. It is worth calling us first: if a driver can still be moved, we will move them.
Give us the flight number and a delay costs you nothing. We track the flight and the driver arrives for the actual landing time; the included waiting allowance starts from then, not from the time you booked.
Delay within the same day: the pickup moves automatically. No call needed.
Flight cancelled or diverted: tell us as soon as you know and we treat it under section
, not as a late cancellation.
No flight number on the booking: we cannot see the delay, so the ordinary waiting rules in the
terms
apply.
Call the number in your confirmation before you make another arrangement, so we have a chance to fix it.
Where our records show you were at the pickup point and no vehicle came, you receive
back.
A booking becomes a no-show once the included waiting time has run out and we have called your number
times with no answer.
Airport pickups:
from the actual landing time.
All other pickups:
from the booked time.
Answer the phone and the driver waits — the extra time is chargeable at
, which is cheaper than losing the transfer.
Where a journey becomes impossible or unsafe through something neither of us controls, we do not treat it as your cancellation. We re-plan first; if the journey cannot happen at all, the money is dealt with under this section rather than under the tiers above.
Always to the original payment method. We cannot redirect a refund to a different card or account.
Approved within
Paid within
days. Your bank may take a few days more to show it.
Bookings paid with a voucher are refunded as a voucher.
Unhappy with the outcome? The complaints route is in the
, and we answer within
days.
Instead of a refund you can take the full value of the booking as a voucher, valid for
. It is worth more than the refunded share, which is why we offer it.
Usable on any route we serve, by anyone you pass it to.
Redeemable against a higher fare — you pay the difference.
Not exchangeable for cash once issued.
Need to cancel now?
Open your booking from the confirmation email, or call us and quote the reference. Same outcome, same written confirmation.

=== contact (28)
The form is live — submitting it empty reaches the error state on its own. This switcher is for review only.
Bleicherstrasse 16
Facebook
Instagram
YouTube
Trustpilot
Four slots, no confirmed URLs. Each one drops out cleanly if the account does not exist.
The archive has
in the imprint and privacy pages,
contact@vamostaxi.eu
in the FAQ, and a personal gmail account in the terms. This page renders one token, and every legal page points at the same one — set it once and the site agrees with itself.
Archived imprint, T&Cs §2, FAQ · Wayback, 2024
The gmail address does not survive.
A personal mailbox in binding terms is a liability, not a channel.
The old footer and FAQ promise “Customer Service 24/7 · Start a Chat”, and the site ran a chat widget. Chat is not in the V1 scope of work. If it is dropped, the footer changes and three answers change with it.
So the chat block opposite is behind the
showLiveChat
tweak. Turn it off and the column closes up — no gap, no orphaned heading, no “coming soon”. Decide it either way; do not ship the promise without the widget.
Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and Trustpilot are slots. A Trustpilot profile exists for the domain but no URL was ever linked, and an unlinked review badge is worth less than none.
Decisions — 3
Form states built — 5
Default · empty and ready
Validation error · per field, plus a summary
Sending · every input locked
Success · with a case reference
Send failed · text preserved
Tokens — 6
The case reference on the success screen is generated in the browser for the mock. In production it comes from the ticket the message opens, and it is what the customer quotes when they chase.

=== faq (12)
This is everything the archived site actually published, regrouped. No desktop search: at this volume a search field is a control that finds nothing. The category chips are the navigation and the growth path — see the growth note at the foot of the page.
Change a booking → cancellation 03
Cancel a ride → cancellation 01
Cancellation policy → cancellation, whole
Tipping → terms 04
Child seats → terms 07
No refund share, window, waiting allowance or baggage dimension is restated on this page. That is the structural fix for the archive's worst contradiction — the old FAQ promised a full refund the terms did not grant.
Search is designed but not shipped: eight questions across three categories are faster to scan than to search, and an empty result state on a set this small reads as a broken site.
Turn it on when the set passes roughly 25 questions or five categories. It goes in the chip row, as a 44px pill field on the same baseline, and the chips become filters. The category headings already carry ids, so nothing needs relaying out.
Each is a new
<section data-grp>
plus one chip. Three tokens on this page; the driver-details lead time is shared with the terms, so it takes the common key.

=== about (17)
Every sentence this changes is
underlined in yellow
below. Nothing moves when you switch — same blocks, same lengths.
A portrait of Ben Othman Houssein, or him beside a vehicle. Cool daylight, no studio background. No photograph exists today, and a founder-led story with a stock face is worse than one with none.
Two vehicles in the brand's register: clean, dark, cool daylight, no people. Until they exist these classes fall back to an icon tile in the booking flow.
The definitive list of cities, resorts and cross-border destinations, and whether any of them are seasonal. It becomes the routes section here and the destination list in the booking flow — one list, two places.
The archived terms declare Vamos a pure intermediary: the transport contract forms between the passenger and a partner carrier, and Vamos disclaims liability for the ride. The service pages sell “our skilled drivers”, “licensed, insured chauffeurs”, “our driver will track your flight”. An About page has to pick one, because it is the page where a customer decides who they are dealing with.
Archived T&Cs §2 vs. book-transfer page · Wayback, 2024
Two sentences carry the whole difference, and both are underlined in yellow above. Switch the control in the header and read the page each way: the blocks, the lengths and the layout are identical, so whichever answer comes back, nothing gets redesigned. The same answer then fills the slots in
The About page was never archived and the live site is offline, so nothing here is recovered — it is written from what the business demonstrably is: a registered Zurich GmbH with a named owner, fixed pricing, airport meet & greet, and a partner-driver network.
Nothing is invented in the other direction either: no fleet size, no ride count, no years in business, no cities-served total, no review score. The legacy site carried an unverifiable “48,350+ routes” claim; nothing of that shape appears here, and if a number arrives later it should arrive with a source.
Decisions — 2
Image slots — 3
Two real photographs are in use: the arrivals hall, and the V-Class for the Van class.
Tokens — 5 · Slot — 1
Driver-details lead time
Economy 3/3 and Van 8/8 are stated as fact — the client confirmed those. Business was never given a capacity.

Drivers and fleet owners
Drive with Vamos
You drive professionally in the Zurich area and you want the work. Every transfer we sell is booked ahead at a fixed price, so the schedule is known before anyone gets in the car. Tell us about yourself — one form, and we take it from there.

Two checks come after this form.

Send application

After you send
Three steps, all of them run by a person. None of them happen inside this page.
We read it

, either way.
Background check
We verify your licence and run a check on you. We ask for the documents and your written consent at that point, not now.
Vehicle inspection
Your car is seen in person before your first transfer. We arrange a time and place with you.
No portal, on purpose
There is no driver login, no application dashboard and nothing to check back on. You send this once; after that we talk to you directly.
Questions before you apply? Call
Client input · who qualifies
Nothing on record says what a Vamos partner must already have — permit class, vehicle age, insurance cover, languages, minimum availability. Until that arrives this stays a gap rather than a guess: the form asks, and a person decides.
A12 · build this page, or unlink it
The footer's Company column links
become-a-partner
and the About page ends with a CTA to it, but the page was never in V1 scope. That is why this one is drawn light: structure, fields and copy, no photography and no illustration to throw away.
Two outcomes.
Build it and this becomes the real funnel. Unlink it and the footer link plus the About CTA come out — and this file goes in the bin, not into V1 half-finished.
Two fields are guesses waiting to be told otherwise
is a free text field, because the partner-side vehicle classes are not agreed. The
vehicleTypeControl
tweak shows the same field as a provisional dropdown so both can be judged side by side — the list in it is body types, not Vamos classes, and is not a final answer.
is one text line. No upload, no document flow, no permit-number format validation — all three are speculative until somebody says what is actually required.
Out of scope · where a submission lands
No backend, no storage, no routing, and no admin table to read applications in. The confirmation state is the end of the deliverable. Whoever picks this up needs an inbox or an ops screen before it can go live.
